ety.text: A Mongolic borrowing, ultimately from Proto-Mongolic *sokar (“blind”) (whence Mongolian сохор (soxor)), which is often used with Proto-Mongolic *noman (“mole; vole; zokor”). The forms recorded in the dialects are зо́кор (zókor) and со́кор (sókor). The literary form цо́кор (cókor) was probably transcribed according to German orthography from zokor found in Pallas's works.
